general_information.Syllabus Name: 3D Modeling & Rigging_Xây dựng mô hình và tạo hệ thống khung xương trong môi trường 3D
general_information.Description: This course covers the fundamentals of working in CG (Computer Graphics) with Maya. It provides an overview of maya, basic modeling tools, working with UVs, textures,basic lighting and rendering using the provided software.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance > - Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: This course covers the fundamentals of working in CG (Computer Graphics) with Maya. It provides an overview of maya, basic modeling tools, working with UVs, textures,basic lighting and rendering using the provided software.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Apply different modeling techniques in Maya: Poly modeling, Subdivision modeling and NURBS modeling
Understand topology and apply it appropriately.
Create a 3D character model that’s proper for aimation
Create and modify material in Maya
Setup lighting, camera and render a scene using Arnold Renderer
Having a positive attitude and a professional working style

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Scenery modeling: Using polygon modeling technique to model a 3D scene (house, building, castle, etc.) and surrounding environment, material not required.
assessments.Grading Guide: Amount of work on material character (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%) Evaluation criteria proposed by teachers in the teaching process

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Character modeling:Using subdivision modeling technique to model a 3D character based on a 2D concept, material not required.
assessments.Grading Guide: Amount of work on environment, object (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%) Evaluation criteria proposed by teachers in the teaching process

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Final render:Applying material to one of the 2 assignments, setup lighting and render.
assessments.Grading Guide: Amount of work on environment, object (60%) and Presentation (25%), and ability to explain and answer questions from evaluator (15%) Evaluation criteria proposed by teachers in the teaching process
Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions
